in_marathi.name: Debjani
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Deb
in_marathi.long_meaning: Debjani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Debjani is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Deb' meaning 'God' and 'Jani' meaning 'born'. Debjani is the name of the Goddess of Deb who is believed to be the goddess of a hundred thousand names, the mother of the Universe.
